_source: film_lessons where scope = 'taste' and active, pulled 2026-08-13. Deliberately taste only: the protocol/design/ritual rows are instructions for how Claude behaves, not facts about what Dixon likes, and hanging those on the wall would be the room talking to itself.

lessons.rule: The antibodies doctrine. He grew up on the copies, not the originals, so pre-2000s twist classics can underperform because later media already strip-mined them.
He runs an execution meritocracy. He pays for CONTROL, not ambition. The reach only counts if the hand closes.
An unguessable IDEA is not the same as an unguessable REVEAL. A wild concept delivered as exposition does not land. It has to be staged as an event happening in real time.
Never split a tension movie across two nights. The held breath breaks and it costs the film real points.
His bad memory is an asset, not a bug. Long-gap rewatches play like first watches and score like them.
The antibodies tax is not automatic. It applies when the pleasure is located in the surprise itself. When the pleasure is craft and scale-of-con, the movie wins anyway.
Soft two hour ceiling on weeknights, broken happily for the right film. Prime window 7pm to midnight.
Group watches skew crowd-pleaser. His solo lane is headier.
Sleepy nights need brains WITH the motion. The choreography button alone does not close a pitch.
The light and fun shelf is viable and was understocked. Counterprogramming against his dread lane works.
Gorgeous, idea-forward films that keep their ensemble deliberately thin cap in the mid-7s. Character investment is a separate line item he docks for.
A great post-movie conversation does not equal a great score. Discussion value and rating are separate currencies.
Structure films score by their human anchor. A loop executed cleanly but mechanism-forward ceilings in the high 7s; the same machine carried by a person he cares about reaches 9.
Movement and music are amplifiers, not foundations. They add real points to films that already have brains; alone they do not close a pitch.
Unearned sentimentality is its own dock, separate from craft. Love-saves-the-day melodrama costs points even in films he enjoys.
